hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

notAttached added (absent -> {reason}): the entry now states that this CommandLineTool implements no Implementation Profile, with the reason already given in docs/ATTACHMENTS.md (profiles.yaml tier3.reason). Nothing else changes: the process was not attached before and is not attached now (decision Q1 of 2026-11-11).

plan: executionUnit.href moves from the v0.0.2-rc2 release of GeoLabs/KindGrove to the v0.0.2-rc3 release (mangrove-workflow-steps.cwl#estimate_biomass). The rc3 CWL declares the format of its Files (the ipython2cwl format annotation), so the processDescription derived from it changes: contentMediaType application/octet-stream -> image/tiff; application=geotiff (with contentEncoding binary) for the inputs ndvi_file, ndwi_file and savi_file and the outputs biomass_file and mangrove_mask_file, and application/octet-stream -> application/geo+json (with contentEncoding binary) for the input stac_item.

prefLabel: Mangrove detection, allometric biomass and IPCC carbon stock
definition: Detects mangrove pixels and estimates above-ground biomass and carbon stock from NDVI, NDWI and SAVI.

notAttached.reason: Domain model: mangrove detection, allometric biomass and carbon stock from three index rasters and coefficients, with five outputs including summaries. No Generic Profile, and none of general use.

openeoEquivalence.rationale: Opaque: a threshold-based mangrove mask (ndvi_min/max, ndwi_min, savi_min) followed by a fixed linear allometric formula (biomass_slope/intercept) and an IPCC carbon_fraction constant. No openEO process expresses a domain-specific regression model, same as `kindgrove.mangrove`.
